sourceSteps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
acceptedReferenceObservation: Supine bent-knee start with heels flat and paws beside head. Revised endpoint lifts lower and upper back above mat into a partial sit-up; pelvis and feet remain planted. Exact 45-degree goniometric measurement is not claimed.
renderingAssumption: Only one controlled partial sit-up is previewed. Knees stay bent and both feet remain fixed; no leg raise or standing.
